closest_to_sbg.citation: Luo et al., 'Semantics-Based Obfuscation-Resilient Binary Diffing', IEEE TIFS 2017
closest_to_sbg.reason: Closest in spirit: uses I/O semantic summaries for equivalence. Differs: binary-only, pairwise, no longitudinal genome.
Directly targets program equivalence across versions. Differs: formal/static, C-only, does not scale.
Semantic diff using symbolic methods. Differs: static, requires matched function pairs, SMT-constrained.

closest_to_sbg.citation: Bayer et al., 'TTAnalyze / Scalable Behavior-Based Malware Clustering', NDSS 2009
closest_to_sbg.reason: Dynamic behavioral fingerprinting at scale. Differs: malware-focused, single-version clustering, not regression.

closest_to_sbg.citation: Yamaguchi et al., 'Code Property Graphs (Joern)', IEEE S&P 2014
closest_to_sbg.reason: Multi-layer program representation (AST+CFG+PDG). Differs: static only, vulnerability-focused, no dynamic dimension.
Rich graph-based program representation for analysis tasks. Differs: LLVM IR only, no runtime values, no longitudinal tracking.

coverage_gaps.label: Longitudinal Behavioral Genome Tracking
coverage_gaps.description: No prior work builds a versioned behavioral genome tracking how a program's full behavioral profile evolves across its entire release history.

coverage_gaps.label: Cross-Language Behavioral Equivalence Without Common IR
coverage_gaps.description: No work establishes behavioral equivalence between programs in fundamentally different paradigms (e.g., Python vs Rust vs Clojure) without requiring a shared compilation target.

coverage_gaps.label: Behavioral Genome as Supply-Chain Artifact
coverage_gaps.description: No prior work treats a behavioral signature as a first-class supply-chain artifact (analogous to an SBOM) capturing behavioral provenance.

coverage_gaps.label: Unsupervised Behavioral Anomaly Detection Without Test Suites
coverage_gaps.description: No work detects behavioral regression purely from unlabeled execution traces using unsupervised anomaly detection over behavioral embeddings.

coverage_gaps.label: Multi-Modal Behavioral Fingerprinting (Source + Binary + Runtime)
coverage_gaps.description: No single framework jointly fingerprints a program at source, binary, and runtime levels and unifies all three into a single behavioral identity.

coverage_gaps.label: Behavioral Diff as a Developer-Facing Code Review Artifact
coverage_gaps.description: No tool produces a human-readable behavioral diff suitable for inclusion in code review, precisely identifying what changed in program behavior rather than code structure.

coverage_gaps.label: Behavioral Genome Across Operating Environments
coverage_gaps.description: No work characterizes how the same binary's behavior diverges across OS versions, hardware architectures, and library versions in a unified behavioral genome model.
